---
title: "DB Schema (Aquaculture)"
subtitle: "The Norwegian aquaculture reference database"
---

```{css, echo=FALSE}
th { white-space: nowrap; }
```

The aquaculture database (`aquaculture_no.sqlite`) is a single-table reference of
Norwegian marine aquaculture sites, active and closed. It is paired with the merged
database: each Norwegian sediment site carries its distance to the nearest farm
(`site.dist_to_aquaculture`). The data cover **Norway only**, from the Norwegian
Directorate of Fisheries site register. How the table is built (coordinate
conversion, translation from Norwegian, salt-water filter) is documented on the
[clean-analyses site](https://seafood-hazards.github.io/multised-clean/).

## aquaculture

One row per site. Salt-water and brackish sites are kept (pure freshwater dropped);
3,743 sites in total (1,554 active, 2,189 closed).

```{r}
library(tibble)
library(knitr)

tribble(
  ~Column,           ~Type,     ~Meaning,
  "aqua_id",         "INTEGER", "Primary key.",
  "loknr",           "INTEGER", "Site number in the Norwegian register.",
  "name",            "TEXT",    "Site name (kept in Norwegian).",
  "latitude",        "REAL",    "Latitude (WGS84), derived from the national grid (ETRS89 / UTM 33N).",
  "longitude",       "REAL",    "Longitude (WGS84), derived from the national grid.",
  "start_year",      "INTEGER", "Year the site was cleared.",
  "end_year",        "INTEGER", "Year the site was withdrawn (NULL for active sites).",
  "active",          "INTEGER", "1 for active, 0 for closed.",
  "water_type",      "TEXT",    "salt, brackish, or fresh/salt.",
  "capacity",        "REAL",    "Cleared (permitted) capacity, as reported.",
  "capacity_unit",   "TEXT",    "Unit of capacity (tonnes, decare, count, ...).",
  "capacity_tonnes", "REAL",    "Capacity converted to tonnes where the unit is a mass; NULL otherwise.",
  "fish_types",      "TEXT",    "Species farmed, translated to English (rare species keep the Norwegian name).",
  "placement",       "TEXT",    "sea or land.",
  "county",          "TEXT",    "County (first name kept where the source is multilingual).",
  "municipality",    "TEXT",    "Municipality (first name kept where the source is multilingual)."
) |> kable()
```

::: {.callout-note}
The aquaculture data are Norwegian only, so the paired `dist_to_aquaculture` column in
the merged database is populated only for Norwegian sediment sites. When international
aquaculture data become available the same column can be extended.
:::
